remarks: Welcome to your new home in the heart of Glenbrook, Stamford! This charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offers convenience, style, and comfort all in one place.  Located in a prime spot with easy access to the train station for commuting to NYC, this condo is perfect for professionals and city enthusiasts alike. The spacious living area welcomes you with abundant natural light and a versatile layout perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests.  One of the standout features of this unit is the in-unit washer and dryer, providing ultimate convenience and eliminating trips to the laundromat. The updated kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting granite countertops, stainless steel refrigeration, and ample cabinet space for storage.  Spacious closets throughout the unit offer plenty of storage for your belongings, while a 10x20 storage room in the basement can be set up as a home gym, perfect for staying active without leaving the comfort of your home.  In addition to the fantastic interior features, residents of this complex also have access to a refreshing pool, ideal for hot summer days and weekend relaxation.  Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to own a stylish and convenient condo in the desirable Glenbrook area of Stamford. Schedule your private tour today and envision yourself living the ideal lifestyle in this wonderful community!
